source.label: The Lord of the Rings complete rulesheet

supportingSources.label: Current Stern code index — CPU and display 10.0

strategy.summary: Prepare Two Towers Multiball and a useful Ring mode, start the mode before the third lock, and add Gollum Multiball or 2x Scoring only when safely ready.

quickInfo.name: Two Towers Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Spell KEEP, lock three balls on the Sword ramp, then build a seven-Jackpot assault and collect Super Jackpots.

quickInfo.name: Ring modes
quickInfo.summary: Collect three Elf rings, select a mode at the center Ring, and start it before a movie multiball.

quickInfo.name: Gollum Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Collect nine Rings of Men and start at Gollum's Cave, where Smeagol phases double scoring and Gollum phases halve it.

quickInfo.name: Palantir
quickInfo.summary: Collect the lit Palantir during a movie multiball for a context-dependent award that usually adds a ball.

quickInfo.name: Destroy the Ring
quickInfo.summary: Play all three movie multiballs, then complete the Ring-shot sequence and knock the held ball through the Ring.

steps.text: Use flipper lane change to spell KEEP, and make safe right-ramp shots to prepare the three Sword locks.
Collect three Elf rings. Select Attack of Shelob or War of the Ents when its required shots are reliable.
modeNotes: Ring mode: Only one Ring mode can run. A mode cannot start during a movie multiball, so begin it before the final lock.
Attack of Shelob: Alternate the lit left and right shot groups.
War of the Ents: Shoot Orthanc six times. The shots also help Return of the King soul progress.

steps.text: Start the Ring mode, then make the third Sword lock to start Two Towers Multiball.
During Two Towers Multiball, make consecutive lit Jackpots quickly. Advance the assault from one through seven Jackpots.
modeNotes: Two Towers Multiball: Consecutive Jackpots raise the assault count. More balls in play increase the Jackpot multiplier.
Super Jackpot phase: Complete the assault, then collect the Ring Super Jackpot and the paired VUK, ramp, and orbit Super Jackpots.

steps.text: Collect the first Super Jackpot to complete the multiball objective and light an Elf Gift.
When nine Rings of Men or Gift 2x Scoring are already close, start them before the stack. Do not risk the main start solely to force them.

fallback.title: Persistent Fellowship route
fallback.when: Use this when the center Ring, Palantir, or final Sword lock has a dangerous return.

steps.text: Collect Fellowship members from their lit shots.
Start Fellowship Multiball at Barad-Dur after all nine members are collected.
Alternate Balrog hits with the lit ramps. Progress survives between starts.
Return to Two Towers only when its qualification shots are under control.

alternatives.title: Return of the King progress
alternatives.when: Use this when shots into Paths of the Dead are safer than the Sword ramp.

steps.text: Send the ball into the Orthanc VUK during regular play so it travels down Paths of the Dead and collects souls. Repeat until the display reaches 5,000 souls.
Start Return of the King at the lit Orthanc, Barad-Dur, or Gollum shot.
Complete the four Ring-related Jackpot stages. The progress carries to later starts.
Complete Fellowship, Two Towers, and Return of the King Multiballs.
Complete Destroy the Ring after all three movie multiballs are played.
Complete all six Ring modes and There and Back Again.
Collect all six Elf Gifts. Complete every requirement to light Valinor.

techniques.name: Gollum's Cave award
techniques.instruction: Make the qualifying flipper route into the VUK. A ball that reaches the VUK from the jets does not collect the lit Gollum award.

cautions.issue: The Palantir target can rebound toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Take it under multiball protection or from a controlled feed. Do not force a pseudo-random award from a bad cradle.

cautions.issue: A right-ramp or Gollum-wireform ball can release a physically locked ball without warning.
cautions.response: Be ready for a second ball whenever you shoot near the lock assembly.

cautions.issue: The inner orbit returns quickly, and weak Ring shots can fall into the ORC lanes or Barad-Dur.
cautions.response: Test these feeds early. Use the safest ready Ring mode instead of forcing the nominal best one.

strategy.simpleOverview: In The Lord of the Rings, three Elf rings start a Ring mode, while spelling K-E-E-P and taking three Sword-ramp locks starts Two Towers Multiball. Start the Ring mode before the third lock when both are ready so the mode continues during Multiball.
strategy.overview: The Lord of the Rings lets a Ring mode continue into a prepared movie Multiball. Collect three Elf rings and choose a controllable mode, prepare K-E-E-P and two Sword-ramp locks, then start the mode before taking the third lock. Add Gollum or 2x only when ready without delaying the main stack.
